run_boost_build_libtiff_test: run the Boost.Build test script that validates libtiff static and shared library linking
test_libtiff_source_build: test building libtiff from source using the Boost.Build mock toolset and verify output artifacts
test_libtiff_static_linking: test linking an executable against libtiff as a static library using the Boost.Build system
test_libtiff_shared_linking: test linking an executable against libtiff as a shared library using the Boost.Build system
test_libtiff_explicit_location: test initializing libtiff with explicit name include and search paths in the Boost.Build system
